# Project Setup Instructions

- [x] Verify that the copilot-instructions.md file in the .github directory is created.

- [x] Clarify Project Requirements
  - Masonry-style portfolio website for photography and design work
  - Static site (no build tools) for easy deployment
  - Responsive, modern design with custom branding

- [x] Scaffold the Project
  - Created HTML pages: index, gallery, about, contact
  - Created CSS with masonry grid layout
  - Created JavaScript for gallery, lightbox, and navigation
  - Created data structure for gallery items

- [x] Customize the Project
  - Applied Space Grotesk and Space Mono fonts
  - Implemented color scheme (primary #0066FF, secondary #FF3366, dark #696969)
  - Added responsive navigation and mobile menu
  - Integrated lightbox with keyboard navigation
  - Added gallery filtering by year

- [x] Install Required Extensions
  - No extensions needed (static HTML/CSS/JS site)

- [x] Compile the Project
  - No compilation needed—ready to open in browser
  - To test locally: open index.html in any browser

- [x] Create and Run Task
  - No build tasks needed
  - Site is deploy-ready as-is

- [x] Launch the Project
  - Open index.html in browser to preview
  - See DEPLOYMENT.md for hosting instructions (Netlify/Cloudflare)

- [x] Ensure Documentation is Complete
  - README.md: full project overview and setup
  - DEPLOYMENT.md: step-by-step deployment guide
  - images/README.md: image specifications
